chapter: Arriving in New York: the Nest Club and Harlem nightlife
title: Rudy Toombs, the dandy actor in Mae West's show
summary: Rudy Toones played Mae West's go-between and wrote One Mint Julep; he told Danny that Mae West was after him.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: All right. So she looked around at me. She said, "You stay after the show. I want to see you." So Rudy Toone(?) was on the show, and he was a sharpie. Mae West told me that...
Rudy was an actor, and he was the go-between between...Mae West's connection from Uptown-Downtown. He was a dandy, in other words.
In the play, he was the contact man for Mae West.

Yeah, he was handsome. You know Rudy Toone(?). He wrote...what's that thing..."One Mint Julep." You'd see him down on Broadway. They killed him, they busted his brains out where Minton's place is. He lived on that block.
Well, Rudy Toone(?). You'd know him if you ever see him, see a picture of him.
